reason: Contract Non-Goals item 4 explicitly excludes 'Compile-time boolean slot type validation' from this bead's scope. PS-TYPE-001 asserts compile-time boolean slot type verification, which is a pre-existing gap not introduced by this bead. Hazard H9 (Boolean Slot Type Mismatch) is documented and mitigated at runtime by replay_choose_slot, which returns ReplayError::Internal for non-Bool condition values. This is a deferred concern requiring a future type-system extension bead.
boundary_proof: The waiver is bounded to the compile-time slot type validation only. The runtime safety net (replay_choose_slot rejecting non-Bool conditions) remains intact and is independently verified by existing replay tests in crates/vb_core/src/replay/choose.rs. The lowering itself does not introduce new namespace hazards because condition slots are always boolean at runtime when authored correctly.
compensating_evidence: 1) Runtime safety: replay_choose_slot returns Internal error for non-bool conditions (test: choose_slot_non_boolean_condition_returns_internal_error). 2) Hazard documented in hazard-analysis.md H9 with mitigation strategy. 3) Existing replay test suite covers all condition type mismatch cases. 4) If a future bead adds compile-time type tracking, this waiver expires and the obligation becomes required.

reason: Deep-nesting body fuzzing at the parser level (vb_yaml) is deferred to parser-level proof work. The choose body lowering itself does not introduce new nesting hazards because depth limits are enforced by the YAML parser (DepthLimit) and node count limit (NodeLimit) before lowering begins. PS-INPUT-002's fuzz target for depth limits is partially deferred: the cargo-fuzz obligation (PO-FUZZ-002) covers compiler-level fuzzing; parser-level fuzzing is out of scope for this bead.
boundary_proof: The parser boundary is the vb_yaml crate, which is unchanged by this bead. The waiver only defers parser-level fuzzing, not compiler-level fuzzing. The compiler receives already-parsed AST; if the parser enforces limits, the compiler cannot receive excessively deep input. PO-FUZZ-002 remains as a compiler-level fuzz obligation covering the compilation paths that could still be exercised by deep but legal YAML.
compensating_evidence: 1) YAML parser enforces DepthLimit and NodeLimit before lowering (hazard-analysis.md H13). 2) PO-FUZZ-002 cargo-fuzz target exercises compiler-level choose depth paths. 3) PO-KANI-011 Kani harness verifies depth limit enforcement within compile_source. 4) Existing YAML parser test suite in vb_yaml covers depth limit enforcement.
